privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy covers Mutaba3a's apps for Mac, Windows, the browser, iPhone, and Android, and the hosted portal you sign in to in a browser. They handle your data in different ways, so we explain each one. It does not cover any other product.

scope.title: The short version
scope.body: On Mac, Windows, and in the browser, Mutaba3a keeps your business data on your own device. There's no account, and nothing you enter in the app is sent to us. Our website sends us what you type in the hosted-account request form, only if you fill it in and press Send, and it counts visits anonymously, as described under "Anonymous usage counts". The iPhone and Android apps work differently: you sign in with an account, and what you enter is saved to Mutaba3a's servers. None of our apps use ads or tracking. The free apps on Mac, Windows, and in the browser, which need no account, never send usage data, and we never sell your data.

dataStorage.title: Mac, Windows, and the browser: your data stays on your device
dataStorage.body: Everything you enter — clients, projects, income, expenses, and receipts — is stored locally: in your browser's storage when you use the web app, or in a local database file when you use the Mac or Windows app. We never see it, and it never leaves your device unless you choose to export it.

mobile.title: iPhone and Android: your account and our servers
mobile.body: The mobile apps need an account, which your organization or we set up for you. There's no public sign-up. When you sign in, we keep your email address, display name, language, and which business profiles you can use. What you enter is stored on Mutaba3a's servers, and a copy is kept on your phone so the app works offline. Entries you make while offline are saved on your phone and uploaded once you're back online. Signing out ends your session on our servers. Entries that haven't uploaded yet stay on the phone and upload after you sign in again.

hostedAccounts.title: Hosted accounts: where your records live
hostedAccounts.body: A hosted account (the web portal, and the iPhone and Android apps when you're signed in) keeps your records on Mutaba3a's servers in Google Cloud's Tel Aviv region (me-west1). We back them up every day and keep each backup for 14 days, and we can restore your records to any moment in the last 7 days. When something breaks, an error report goes to Sentry in the EU with the content of your records removed. Usage counts go to PostHog in the EU only if you agree. Our team opens your records only when you ask us to help, to fix a fault, or when the law requires it. When you close your account, we delete it and its records after 30 days, including the record that you accepted our terms, and our backups clear 14 days later. Hosted accounts are also covered by our terms of service.

whatYouEnter.title: What you enter
whatYouEnter.body: You control what goes into Mutaba3a: client names and contact details, projects, income records, optional expenses, notes, and any receipts you attach. On Mac, Windows, and in the browser, none of this is sent to us. In the mobile apps, it's sent to our servers so it can be stored with your account. On iPhone, you can share a photo or PDF of a receipt into Mutaba3a. It's uploaded to private cloud storage and attached to the expense.

network.title: What reaches the network
network.body: On Mac, Windows, and in the browser, the app makes two kinds of outbound requests, and neither includes anything you've entered: it asks a public exchange-rate service (Frankfurter) for currency conversion rates, and the download page checks GitHub for the latest release version. Separately, the website's hosted-account request form sends what you type in it to Netlify when you press Send. The website also sends the anonymous visit counts described under "Anonymous usage counts" to PostHog. The hosted portal connects to Mutaba3a's servers and, if you turned on anonymous usage, to PostHog. The mobile apps connect to Mutaba3a's servers, to the private storage that holds your receipts, and, if you turned on anonymous usage, to PostHog, always over encrypted connections.

sharing.title: Who else handles your data
sharing.body: We don't sell your data or share it with advertisers. Our servers and receipt storage run on Google Cloud, which processes the data only to host it for us. Our website runs on Netlify, which receives the hosted-account request form and checks each request for spam with Akismet (made by Automattic). PostHog, hosted in the EU, processes the anonymous usage counts described under "Anonymous usage counts" for us. If your organization has linked its business profiles to Malafat, the records in those profiles are shared between Malafat and Mutaba3a. Beyond that, we disclose data only when the law requires it.

security.title: Keeping the mobile apps secure
security.body: Your password is stored on our servers only as a secure hash, and never on your phone. Your sign-in session is kept in the iPhone Keychain or in Android's encrypted storage. You can turn on App Lock so opening the app needs Face ID, Touch ID, your fingerprint, or your device passcode. That check happens on your device, and Mutaba3a never receives your biometric data. The mobile apps don't use your camera, contacts, or location, and they only see a photo or file when you choose to share it into the app.

noTracking.title: No ads, no tracking
noTracking.body: None of Mutaba3a's apps use advertising, crash reporting, or tracking that follows you across sites or apps, and the free apps on Mac, Windows, and in the browser use no analytics at all. The anonymous usage counts we do keep are described under "Anonymous usage counts". The Mac, Windows, and browser apps have no sign-up or login at all. Our servers keep standard technical logs (such as when a request arrived, its IP address, and whether it succeeded) so we can run the service. We don't use them to profile you.

usageAnalytics.title: Anonymous usage counts
usageAnalytics.body: The free apps on Mac, Windows, and in the browser never send usage data. Where we do count usage, we use PostHog, hosted in the EU. We never send amounts, names, notes, contact details, your location, or anything you type, and nothing we send is linked to your account. Our website counts page visits and which buttons are pressed, without cookies and without storing anything on your device. To tell visits apart for a single day, PostHog combines your IP address and browser details into a code that changes every day and keeps neither, so a visit can't be linked to you or to visits on other days. The hosted portal asks you once whether you want to share anonymous usage, and it's off unless you turn it on. If you do, it sends a short note when you turn it on (saying whether you did so from the prompt or the account menu), each time you open the portal, and each time you save an income or an expense. A note says only which of these it was, its currency, and for an income whether it was already paid, along with the portal's version and its analytics library's version, its language, your browser's type, your device's operating system and its version, and whether it's a computer, tablet, or phone. Notes are sent under a random ID kept only in your browser, not linked to your account, and replaced when you sign out. If you turn it off from the account menu, we send one last note saying you turned it off, then stop and delete the random ID. The iPhone and Android apps ask you once whether you want to share anonymous usage, and it's off unless you turn it on. If you do, they send a short note each time you turn it on (saying whether you did so from the prompt or Settings), once more the first time you turn it on after signing in, and each time you add a client or save an income or an expense. A note says only which of these it was, its currency, and for an income whether it was already paid, along with the app's version and its analytics library's version, its language, your phone's operating system and its version, and whether it's a phone or a tablet. Notes are sent under a random ID kept only on your phone, not linked to your account, and replaced when you sign out. If you turn it off in Settings, we send one last note saying you turned it off, then stop and delete the random ID. These counts are used only to understand which parts of Mutaba3a people use. They're never used for advertising, and no one but PostHog, which processes them for us, receives them.

yourControl.title: Mac, Windows, and the browser: exporting and deleting your data
yourControl.body: You can export a full backup of your data as a file at any time, and import it back in. Deleting your data is just as direct: clearing the app's storage (or uninstalling the desktop app) removes it completely, because there's no copy anywhere else.

mobileDeletion.title: Deleting your account and mobile data
mobileDeletion.body: You can delete individual entries in the mobile apps. To delete your whole account and everything stored with it, email info@malafat.app from your account's email address, and we'll do it within 30 days. Records in a business profile that belongs to your organization are your organization's, so we handle those together with them. Copies in our backups expire within 14 days of deletion. Signing out and uninstalling the app removes Mutaba3a's data from your phone.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.body: Mutaba3a is a business tool and isn't directed at children. We don't knowingly collect information from anyone under 13.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy changes, we'll update this page and the "Last updated" date above.

hostedRequest.title: When you ask for a hosted account
hostedRequest.body: If you send the request form on our website, Netlify, which hosts the website, receives what you type: your name, your email and anything else you choose to add, plus the language the page was in and a random request number. Netlify also records technical details such as your IP address and browser, and checks the request for spam with Akismet. Netlify then emails it to us. We use it only to reply with an offer and, if you go ahead, to set up your account. We delete requests within 12 months; write to info@malafat.app and we'll delete yours sooner.

contact.body: Questions about this policy can be sent to info@malafat.app. Mutaba3a is made by Barmajiyat Ltd.
